name: sk-voice-orb
title: Voice Orb
description: A microphone target whose ring reacts to real audio level, drawn in a single Canvas so 44 bars cost one draw instead of 44 layout passes. Uses asymmetric smoothing — fast attack, slow release — which is why it tracks speech instead of wobbling behind it, and two incommensurate waves so the ring never visibly loops.
author: Ahmed Gagan
